messages:
maria: quick one — PR #3147 is blocked by a lint failure in proto/gen/runner_proto.go. I pushed a tiny import reorder but CI still shows a gofmt mismatch. can someone run `gofmt` locally and confirm what I'm missing?

ankit: is that file generated? if so we should regenerate with protoc instead of hand-editing. which generator did you use?

maria: it is generated by tools/proto-gen (we landed a generator change last week). i ran `make gen-protos` but my local gofmt seems to differ from CI. here's what CI shows in the patch: `style: gofmt -w required`

format-bot: detected gofmt issue in files: proto/gen/runner_proto.go (PR #3147). suggested command: `gofmt -w proto/gen/runner_proto.go`

derek: i'll grab this. two quick checks: 1) do you have go1.20 vs CI using go1.21? 2) are we using gofumpt in CI (it enforces extra rules)? run `gofmt` then `gofumpt -w` to be safe.

jess: if it's generated, prefer regenerating and committing the generated file so CI is deterministic. if that still fails, post the diff here.

ankit: commands i run to fix these usually:
```
make gen-protos
# ensure toolchain version: asdf local golang 1.21
gofmt -w proto/gen/runner_proto.go
gofumpt -w proto/gen/runner_proto.go  # optional if we use gofumpt
git add proto/gen/runner_proto.go
git commit -m "regenerate runner proto + gofmt"
```

maria: thanks — i switched to go1.21, re-ran `make gen-protos` and `gofumpt -w`. pushed a new commit `3147-fix/proto-format` (force-pushed). CI started a new run.

derek: quick glance at the diff — looks like only import ordering and a couple small whitespace bits. LGTM from me.

jess: also LGTM. please wait for the new CI job to finish, but this is unblockable. merge window opens in 10m, i'll take it if CI is green. :thumbsup:

maria: amazing, thanks everyone! i'll watch CI and ping when green. :pray:
